listing.name: Armour Visualiser
listing.summary: does what it says on the tin. (and also weapon arcs) updated for .98, no crashes afaik, yell at me if it does
listing.aiSummary: Visualises ship armour coverage and weapon firing arcs.

description: Displays a grid overlay on ships to show armour zones. It also visualises weapon firing arcs and escort package ranges. Keybinds for these features are configured in the LunaSettings menu.
